text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track their progress. Breaking a project into milestones makes it easier to monitor achievements along the way and keeps everyone motivated. It is also important to define deliverables clearly so that everyone understands what needs to be completed. Finally, stakeholder alignment ensures that all key people share the same expectations and support the project from start to finish.
